papers.summary: 利用视觉-语言模型的开放词汇能力，实现工业场景的零样本异常检测。

papers.title: Embodied Agent Navigation with Hierarchical Semantic Maps
papers.summary: 构建层级化语义地图，使具身智能体能够理解复杂室内环境并执行长期导航任务。

papers.title: Unified Multi-Agent System with Theory of Mind
papers.summary: 赋予 AI Agent 心智理论能力，实现多智能体间的意图推理与协作规划。

papers.title: Fully Test-Time Adaptation in Extreme Battlefield Scenarios
papers.summary: 无微调时间窗口的在线模型参数演化，实现极端战场环境下的实时适应。

papers.title: Efficient Edge-Cloud Collaborative Inference for Large Vision Models
papers.summary: 提出端云协同推理框架，将大视觉模型高效部署到边缘设备。

papers.title: Federated Learning with Differential Privacy for Cross-Domain Recognition
papers.summary: 在保护隐私的前提下实现跨域联邦学习，适用于多医院医疗影像分析。

papers.title: Adaptive Model Partitioning for Heterogeneous Edge Devices

papers.summary: 利用时空一致性约束实现边缘实时视频分析，延迟降低至 30ms。

papers.title: World Model Predictive Control for Robotic Manipulation

papers.title: Neural Radiance Fields with Uncertainty Quantification

papers.title: Continual Learning for 3D Object Detection via Experience Replay
